data.body: Implementation finding: repository formatting expanded the generalized probe to 1,127 lines, above the canonical 800-line cap. Split at the existing call-graph seam: rollout/tracker parsing and statistical primitives move to scripts/rebar_duration_probe_support.py; scripts/rebar_duration_probe.py remains the thin CLI/reporting layer. Both remain stdlib-only and independently import-safe. File impact was updated before creating the support module; a fresh plan review will be required because material changed.
